title.narrative: Southern Africa Trade and Transport Facilitation (Phase 2) Project

description.narrative: The objective of the Southern Africa Trade and Transport Facilitation Program - Phase 2 is to facilitate the movement of goods and people along the North-South Corridor and at the key border crossings in Malawi, whilst supporting improvements in road safety and health services along the corridor.
